direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; enlarge rendered scene to at least 70% of main; condense side content inside its reserved zone without inspector scrolling
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 headings, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary; emerald/neon #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory scene to at least 70% of main and refit evidence cards into the reserved side zone; the current 60/40 split undercuts scene dominance.
Replace boxy station cards with a cinematic SVG line showing Dock, QA, Receiving hold, both mills and JOB-1001/JOB-1002 with bidirectional highlighting.
Raise rail and legend labels toward 12px minimum and body copy to 16px/24; several micro-labels read below comfortable size at 1366x768.
Visually separate provider identity readiness from the investigation evidence task with distinct headings, status lines and controls, keeping the current functional separation clearer at a glance.
Enlarge the scene to at least 70% of main and shrink the side panel; keep Check selected route and Run Spark Open as the only primary progression path.
Add visible 2px emerald focus ring states for the route select, Check selected route and rail items, with arrow-key movement on the rail.
Enlarge the scene to at least 70% of main; verified findings should highlight the corresponding Certificate track and feasible route in the SVG rather than sit isolated in the side zone.
Condense the findings panel so Verified facts, Rejected claims and Feasible paths metrics align at 26px tabular scale without crowding the collapsible evidence rows.
Clarify that the completed investigation belongs to the prior route while Run Wonder is the next distinct task, using one status sentence.
Make each Select this path control at least 36px tall with a clear selected state; selecting an option should open the typed consent form as the next surface.
Link each tradeoff row to its SVG route and job allocation on hover and focus, showing 83h/$0, 35h/$3,115 and 17.5h/$3,202.50 consistently.
Enlarge the scene to at least 70% of main by narrowing the comparison zone while keeping finish and incremental metrics legible at 16px.
Keep the proposed tasks clearly marked PROPOSED and untracked until approval in both scene cards and side zone; retain the single Approve Britt's proposal primary.
Refit t1-t3 cards as job/station zones tied to Receiving, CELL-MILL-1 40h and CELL-MILL-2 24h so capacity reads spatially, not only as text.
Remove the progress-like bars on unapproved tasks or label them as dependency position, since they imply tracked progress before approval.
Strengthen the previewed stopped state on CELL-MILL-2 with silver cross-hatching plus a cross marker and plain OFFLINE text before Apply second shock is pressed.
Keep the accepted Split route visible but mark it as at-risk in the scene, so invalidation consequence is understood without reading the side zone.
Enlarge the factory line to at least 70% of main and reduce side narration to one instruction and one consequence sentence.
Correct CELL-MILL-2 rendering to consistent silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text; the large X strokes differ from the specified stopped pattern.
Keep provider identity readiness separate from reinvestigation of source evidence, with independent status for the changed-capacity snapshot.
Show 3 to 2 feasible paths directly on the SVG by removing the route through CELL-MILL-2 and marking Split available capacity as constrained in-scene.
Align the constrained Split row treatment across scene and side zone using silver hatching, cross marker and plain text, with the reason Split requires at least two online compatible cells.
Make Wait and Use verified substitute selectable rows drive SVG highlighting, and ensure selection opens the typed consent form for the revised decision.
Reduce the empty lower side zone by enlarging tradeoff rows to 16px body and giving the Human Decision status a reserved, prominent zone.
Preserve coexistence clearly: approved revised plan, 3 BLOCKED prior tasks in a separate hatched zone, and 3 PROPOSED replacements untracked until approval, with no merged counts.
Mark CELL-MILL-2 in the top station row as OFFLINE with silver cross-hatching and cross marker to match the second-shock state, rather than plain text only.
Differentiate blocked prior t1 in the side zone from proposed t1 by title suffix or status label so task identity is not confused.
Enlarge the proof scene to at least 70% of main and refit Verify, Seal and Retain as sequential SVG-linked stages with READY/LOCKED states readable at distance.
Keep Verify ledger as the sole primary until enabled progression changes; passphrase guidance should remain 16px and not compete with the primary action.
Summarise retained evidence in one status sentence beside 70 parts, 35h accepted plan and 48h comparison, avoiding repeated checklist narration in the reserved side zone.
